documents.title: Academic Integrity (Writing Center)
documents.quality_note: One sentence lists 'unattributed AI use' as academic misconduct; the rest is plagiarism and citation help. It is the only rule-bearing AI text found at the university level.

documents.unit: Center for Faculty Excellence (AI Faculty Learning Community), Teaching and Learning at CSU pressbook
documents.title: Example Policy Statements for AI in Higher Education
documents.quality_note: Sample syllabus statements that faculty can adapt, not an institutional rule. Included because it is the earlier-pass URL and the only substantive AI text found; the coder should treat it as exemplar guidance.

notes: No university-wide AI policy found. csuohio.edu/ai/resources-for-students and /resources-for-faculty are link hubs with no rules (not collected). csuohio.edu/studentconduct/academic-integrity-resources has no AI policy text beyond tool-link titles (not collected). Third-party summaries (Trinka) say AI use is set by instructors, but that is not a primary source. No CS department or college-of-engineering AI policy found by search.
